subject.title: fix(line): AI-assisted - requireMention can now optionally gate non-text messages with bounded pending-media retention

question: Should LINE add these two opt-in group settings and own an in-memory retained-media lifecycle across separate webhook messages?
rationale: Current main intentionally allows non-text media through because LINE supplies no mention metadata, while this PR creates a new public configuration, retention, and same-group scheduling contract that requires maintainer product intent beyond code correctness.

options.title: Accept after lifecycle repair
options.body: Keep both opt-in settings, align retained media with cleanup, and require live LINE proof before merge.

options.title: Gate without retention
options.body: Add only non-text mention gating and accept that skipped media is not carried into a later mentioned turn.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Decline the new configuration surface and continue allowing non-text media through mention-gated LINE groups.

recommendation.title: Accept after lifecycle repair
recommendation.body: Keep both opt-in settings, align retained media with cleanup, and require live LINE proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the foundational LINE mention-gating behavior and are the strongest available history-backed owner for this adjacent public contract decision.
